assumptions: Specificity is counted against the transcriptome given, each transcript weighted by the expression given (1 where none is).
Melting temperature by nearest neighbours (SantaLucia & Hicks 2004) with a linear formamide correction.
limits: Off-targets are exact shared k-mers, not alignments: a near match is not counted.
Without rRNA/tRNA sequences that screen does not run, and the result says so.
Designs one transcript's probes; the codebook (which gene gets which codeword) is an input.
bio.jane/contract.question: Which encoding probes make this transcript readable in a MERFISH experiment under this codeword, and how specific is each?

description: Design MERFISH encoding probes for the subject transcript: tile it into target regions, keep those whose G+C and melting temperature fall in their windows, that share no k-mer with an rRNA or tRNA, and whose k-mers occur in this gene's transcripts and nowhere else in the transcriptome; attach readout sequences that spell the gene's codeword, add the amplification primers, screen the whole oligo again, select probes that cover every on-bit evenly with least overlap, and drop probes complementary to one another. Each stage reports how many it kept.

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.

barcode.description: the gene's codeword, one 0 or 1 per bit, 1 where the bit is on.

cross_talk_k.description: k-mer length of the library-wide cross-hybridization screen. Advanced.

expression.description: expression per transcript, one 'id value' line each (FPKM or TPM). Empty: every transcript weighs 1, MERFISH_probe_design's own choice without expression data. Advanced.

formamide.description: formamide in the hybridization buffer. In %. Advanced.

forward_primer.description: forward primer; its reverse complement ends the oligo. Only applies when reverse_primer is set. Advanced.

max_gc.description: highest G+C of a target region (exclusive). In %.

max_readout_ot_increase.description: drop a probe whose readouts add this many expression-weighted off-target k-mers or more (the single-molecule pipeline's check). Empty: not checked. Advanced.

max_rtrna_ot.description: highest rRNA/tRNA off-target count to keep (exclusive); 0.5 keeps only regions with none. Advanced.

max_tm.description: highest melting temperature of a target region (exclusive). In °C.

min_gc.description: lowest G+C of a target region (exclusive). In %.

min_specificity.description: lowest specificity to keep (exclusive): the share of a region's k-mers found only in this gene.

min_tm.description: lowest melting temperature of a target region (exclusive). In °C.

one_bit_per_probe.description: give each probe copies of a single readout. Advanced.

probe_nm.description: concentration of each probe. In nM. Advanced.

readout_assignment.description: how each probe's on-bits are drawn: balanced keeps every on-bit equally used down the transcript. Advanced.

readouts.description: the readout sequences as FASTA, one per bit, in bit order.

readouts_per_probe.description: readout sequences carried by each probe, split between its two ends.

reverse_primer.description: reverse primer, T7 promoter at its 5' end. Empty: no primers are added. Advanced.

rtrna_k.description: k-mer length of the rRNA/tRNA screen. Advanced.

rtrna_reference.description: rRNA and tRNA sequences as FASTA. An Ensembl ncRNA FASTA is filtered to those biotypes by its headers. Empty: the rRNA/tRNA screen does not run.

seed.description: seed for the random draws in readout assignment and selection. Advanced.

sodium_mm.description: monovalent salt of the hybridization buffer. In mM. Advanced.

spacer.description: bases between each readout and the target. Advanced.

specificity_k.description: k-mer length of the specificity and readout off-target counts. Advanced.

t7_length.description: bases of the reverse primer lost in in vitro transcription. In nt. Only applies when reverse_primer is set. Advanced.

target_id.description: the transcript to design for, by its FASTA id. Empty: the transcript whose sequence is the subject's. Advanced.

target_length.description: length of each target region. In nt.

transcriptome.description: every transcript of the organism as FASTA (RefSeq titles name the gene in their last parentheses); the subject is found in it by sequence.

trials.description: selection runs; the one with the most even on-bit coverage is kept. Advanced.

name: design_merfish_probes

explanation.description: the derivation chain: conclusion, interpretation and machinery, generated from this run

orderTable.description: every probe as a Name/Sequence table for pool ordering

probeCount.description: how many encoding probes were kept

probes.description: the selected encoding probes in selection order, each with its 0-based shift, target, G+C, Tm, specificity, isospecificity, readouts, barcode and the oligo to order

report.description: the transcript-level report: probes, probes per on-bit, the fewest on any bit, and how many could be placed without overlap before and after selection

stages.description: what each stage took in and kept, in pipeline order, with the reason a skipped stage did not run
